name: com.dryrelhub.supabasegameachievements
description: Engine-agnostic, offline-first achievement system with batched idempotent server sync, crash-safe local storage, an optional notification overlay and optional Unity Localization support.

samples.description: Bootstrap, gameplay usage, a sample manifest and a Supabase session source driven by an existing sign-in system.
Lua functions UnlockAchievement/HasAchievement and the UnlockAchievement() sequencer command for Dialogue System for Unity (Pixel Crushers).

Ready-to-use PatreonAchievementsBootstrap for games built on DryreL Hub's Unity Patreon Authenticator, plus a Tools > DryreL Hub > Setup Achievements (Patreon) In Scene menu command that adds it with no code. Requires that plugin to be in the project - import this sample only if you have it, so projects without it are never affected.
